greeting: Hey there, plugin aficionados and code whisperers!
introParagraph: This week, the 'Release Radar' pings are lighting up with a solid mix of innovation and crucial stability fixes. We've got some exciting new features rolling out, giving your users more control and your sites more functionality, alongside the usual slew of performance tweaks and bug squashes that keep the WordPress ecosystem humming. It seems everyone's getting ready for what's next!

highlights.title: Sugar Calendar Lite 3.13.0
highlights.summary: Sweetening the deal, Sugar Calendar Lite now offers a **NEW** Registration Form, allowing you to collect custom details like meal choices or t-shirt sizes during ticket checkout or RSVP registration. This is a game-changer for event organizers looking for more granular attendee data!

highlights.title: Envira Gallery Lite 1.15.1
highlights.summary: Get ready to meet your new creative companion! Envira Gallery Lite introduces an AI Image Assistant preview directly in the gallery editor. This looks like a promising step towards streamlining image curation and enhancement workflows.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Social Post Feed 4.12.0
highlights.summary: Smash Balloon is smashing accessibility barriers! This update brings significant improvements to the feed builder and Facebook feed, making them far more accessible to keyboard and screen reader users, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Inclusive design wins!

highlights.title: Charitable 1.8.12.2
highlights.summary: Donation reporting just got more robust with Charitable's latest fix. The 'Reports > Overview' will no longer time out on long date ranges, ensuring you can reliably access crucial financial data without a hitch. Every penny counts, and so does every report!
